ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description: A stack of bees is 1 character until separated. If you attack with stack, add +1 to the cards value per bee (not counting the bottom bee). If a stack is attacked, damage is dealt to ONLY the bee on the top. If a card says to deal damage to a character, only the top bee takes the damage.A boost value of is equal to the number of bees in a stack. If you have multiple stacks, select the one you want. Bob does not count as a stack.
